name: taisly
description: Publish and schedule short-form videos to TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, and Facebook through Taisly.

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP MCP server with OAuth. Remote publishing uses public video URLs.

npm.description: Local stdio MCP server for agents that need to publish local video files.

tools.name: taisly_agent_setup_start
tools.description: Start browser-based Taisly authentication for an AI agent.

tools.name: taisly_agent_checkin
tools.description: Finish setup after the user approves authentication.

tools.name: taisly_platform_schema
tools.description: Get posting constraints for a destination platform.

tools.name: taisly_platform_connect_check
tools.description: Check whether a social account connection completed.

tools.name: taisly_posts_validate
tools.description: Validate media, destinations, caption, and schedule.

tools.name: taisly_posts_create
tools.description: Publish or schedule a confirmed video post.

tools.name: taisly_posts_status
tools.description: Get status for a Taisly post.

tools.name: taisly_reposts_create
tools.description: Create a repost automation between connected accounts.

examples.title: Publish a confirmed video post
examples.description: Validate a video and destination accounts, request explicit confirmation, then publish or schedule it.
examples.prompt: List my connected accounts, validate this video post, and ask me to confirm before publishing it.

examples.title: Audit recent posts
examples.description: Review recent publishing history and status.
examples.prompt: List my recent Taisly posts and summarize their current status.
